title: P.10 Inverse Functions

icans: I can verify that two functions are inverses.
I can use the Horizontal Line Test to decide whether a function has an inverse function.
I can find an inverse function algebraically.

vocab: a function in which each output comes from __________ one input

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)
